name: Socuéllamos (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, white at the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Socuéllamos (a castle and a cross of Saint James), light blue above, red at the fly and green below.
history: The flag of the town, in colours accepted by the council of Socuéllamos on 18 June 1998, measures 100 by 150 cm and is formed of four colours arranged per saltire.
